entries.title: Job 41:1
segments: ¶Canst thou draw out leviathan with an hook? or his tongue with a cord [which] thou lettest down? {leviathan: probably an extinct animal of some kind} {which...: Heb. which thou drownest?}

words.text: ? {leviathan: probably an extinct animal of some kind} {which...: Heb. which thou drownest?}

entries.title: Job 41:2
segments: Canst thou put an hook into his nose? or bore his jaw through with a thorn?

entries.title: Job 41:3
segments: Will he make many supplications unto thee? will he speak soft [words] unto thee?

entries.title: Job 41:4
segments: Will he make a covenant with thee? wilt thou take him for a servant for ever?

entries.title: Job 41:5
segments: Wilt thou play with him as [with] a bird? or wilt thou bind him for thy maidens?

entries.title: Job 41:6
segments: Shall the companions make a banquet of him? shall they part him among the merchants?

entries.title: Job 41:7
segments: Canst thou fill his skin with barbed irons? or his head with fish spears?

entries.title: Job 41:8
segments: Lay thine hand upon him, remember the battle, do no more.

entries.title: Job 41:9
segments: Behold, the hope of him is in vain: shall not [one] be cast down even at the sight of him?

entries.title: Job 41:10
segments: None [is so] fierce that dare stir him up: who then is able to stand before me?

words.text: : who then is able to stand

entries.title: Job 41:11
segments: ¶Who hath prevented me, that I should repay [him? whatsoever is] under the whole heaven is mine.

words.text: [him? whatsoever is] under the whole heaven

entries.title: Job 41:12
segments: I will not conceal his parts, nor his power, nor his comely proportion.

entries.title: Job 41:13
segments: Who can discover the face of his garment? [or] who can come [to him] with his double bridle? {with: or, within}

entries.title: Job 41:14
segments: Who can open the doors of his face? his teeth [are] terrible round about.

entries.title: Job 41:15
segments: [His] scales [are his] pride, shut up together [as with] a close seal. {scales: Heb. strong pieces of shields}

entries.title: Job 41:16
segments: One is so near to another, that no air can come between them.

entries.title: Job 41:17
segments: They are joined one to another, they stick together, that they cannot be sundered.

entries.title: Job 41:18
segments: By his neesings a light doth shine, and his eyes [are] like the eyelids of the morning.

entries.title: Job 41:19
segments: Out of his mouth go burning lamps, [and] sparks of fire leap out.

entries.title: Job 41:20
segments: Out of his nostrils goeth smoke, as [out] of a seething pot or caldron.

entries.title: Job 41:21
segments: His breath kindleth coals, and a flame goeth out of his mouth.

entries.title: Job 41:22
segments: In his neck remaineth strength, and sorrow is turned into joy before him. {is turned into joy: Heb. rejoiceth}

words.text: him. {is turned into joy: Heb. rejoiceth}

entries.title: Job 41:23
segments: The flakes of his flesh are joined together: they are firm in themselves; they cannot be moved. {flakes: Heb. fallings}

words.text: in themselves; they cannot be moved

entries.title: Job 41:24
segments: His heart is as firm as a stone; yea, as hard as a piece of the nether [millstone].

entries.title: Job 41:25
segments: When he raiseth up himself, the mighty are afraid: by reason of breakings they purify themselves.

entries.title: Job 41:26
segments: The sword of him that layeth at him cannot hold: the spear, the dart, nor the habergeon. {habergeon: or, breastplate}

entries.title: Job 41:27
segments: He esteemeth iron as straw, [and] brass as rotten wood.

entries.title: Job 41:28
segments: The arrow cannot make him flee: slingstones are turned with him into stubble.

entries.title: Job 41:29
segments: Darts are counted as stubble: he laugheth at the shaking of a spear.

entries.title: Job 41:30
segments: Sharp stones [are] under him: he spreadeth sharp pointed things upon the mire. {Sharp stones: Heb. Sharp pieces of potsherd}

words.text: . {Sharp stones: Heb. Sharp pieces of potsherd}

entries.title: Job 41:31
segments: He maketh the deep to boil like a pot: he maketh the sea like a pot of ointment.

entries.title: Job 41:32
segments: He maketh a path to shine after him; [one] would think the deep [to be] hoary.

entries.title: Job 41:33
segments: Upon earth there is not his like, who is made without fear. {is made without fear: or, behave themselves without fear}

words.text: . {is made without fear: or, behave themselves without fear}

entries.title: Job 41:34
segments: He beholdeth all high [things]: he [is] a king over all the children of pride.
